name: Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund
oneLiner: USCC is Bitwise's crypto carry fund share, earning basis and staking income with market-day USD or USDC redemption through Superstate.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USCC is a direct NAV-accreting fund share issued by a Delaware statutory-trust series. Its cash-and-carry strategy combines crypto spot and staking positions with short derivatives and Treasury exposure. This supports the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype; navToken independently establishes cash-equivalent listing class under the listing-policy precedence rules, without classifying the fund as a Treasury-only book.

collateral: Managed crypto cash-and-carry portfolio including BTC, ETH, SOL staking and XRP spot exposure, CME/Coinbase derivatives, USD collateral and USTB fund shares. Published holdings include signed derivative marks and negative USDC balances, not a Treasury-only reserve basket.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share, not a $1 peg. NAV is assets less liabilities divided by shares, marked each business day using crypto and futures closes, staking conversion rates and dealer OTC marks. Qualified Purchasers with allowlisted wallets redeem through Superstate for USD or USDC; requests before 5pm ET settle T+1 and later requests T+2.

proofOfReserves.provider: Ernst & Young LLP is the named fund auditor; public holdings are unaudited and no signed current scoped financial report or token-to-share reconciliation was retrieved.
